shared_elements: procession of figures facing one direction
horizontal register bands framing a figural scene
incised script signs on the surface
justification: Both show human figures rendered in profile moving in one direction within a horizontally banded field, with circular motifs (rosettes in one, a rayed disc in the other) and some inscribed signs, but these are generic correspondences. A depicts a large naturalistically modelled humped animal led by attendants along a single ornament-framed frieze, while B depicts a rayed disc shining on adorants before an offering table above dozens of dense lines of script — different subjects, relationships and overall composition.
